youtube.description:
Kiro bugfix spec vs feature spec vs design-first: how to choose

Four questions to pick the right type of Kiro spec.

1. New feature? - Use a feature spec. Requirements come first.
2. Fixing a bug? - Use a bugfix spec. bugfix.md replaces requirements.md.
3. Know the design? - Try design-first. Start from design.md.
4. Not sure? - Start with a feature spec and review it.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/blog/specs-bugfix-and-design-first/
